Plain dried mango slices for human consumption, no added sugar, no added sulphites, not candied or otherwise prepared, non-organic test assumption, bulk food-grade liners in 10 kg cartons

sources.assessment: Commercial export declaration procedure is relevant to the Indonesian dispatch leg; exemptions and product-specific restrictions require shipment facts.
Indonesian government coffee-to-Singapore guide; packaged-food rules are conditional on packing. Civet-coffee-specific conditions are excluded from these non-civet test goods.
Commercial food importer and category requirements apply to the Singapore recipient. Meat, eggs and fish conditions are excluded; exact coffee product category remains a declared review item.
China Customs outbound goods declaration and commercial documents are relevant. Import-only rules are excluded; control status depends on final technical specifications/end use.
Singapore commercial imports require commodity classification and the relevant permit workflow; CA controls must be checked for the final bare-board specification.
Kenyan commercial exporter registration and customs process are relevant; fresh-produce phytosanitary conditions are not automatically applied to plain dried slices.
Plant-health certification depends on the Annex XI/XII commodity listing. This general source does not establish that dried mango requires the certificate required for fresh mango.
Dried-mango-specific European market, food-safety and bulk-price context. Retail prices and other origins cannot be treated as a Kenya FOB or delivered-Germany executable quote.
Export working-capital purpose matches pre-shipment procurement; business eligibility, actual currency availability, interest and fees remain lender-confirmed/quote-required.
Pre-shipment packing loan requires an acceptable export LC and bank credit line; it is incompatible with an open-account-only scenario. Published maximum is not approval or a firm advance rate.

Separate pre-shipment confirmed-order funding from post-shipment invoice/LC discounting; post-shipment funds cannot cure an earlier production deficit. Eligibility, pricing and tenor remain unconfirmed.
Daily ICO indicator in US cents/lb is a market reference, not an Indonesia-origin specific grade/MOQ/Incoterm quotation. Retain observation date and exclude it from executable pricing.

Manufacturer's promotional prototype price is for a small quantity and configurable board specifications; exclude it as a comparator for the 1000-board test lot and request a Gerber/specification quote.
Carrier service/port reference supports logistics discovery, not a booked sailing, guaranteed transit time, shipment capacity or freight quote.
Carrier Kenya service reference; an end-to-end Mombasa-to-Germany itinerary, transshipment, date, food handling and charges require a shipment-specific carrier quote.
International six-digit nomenclature supports unroasted, non-decaffeinated coffee. US national tariff rates and suffixes are excluded from the Indonesia/Singapore test.
Printed-circuit nomenclature is consistent with bare etched boards; populated assemblies are excluded. US national rates and suffixes are not Singapore or China tariff treatment.
International six-digit heading covers mangoes fresh or dried. US duty rates and national subdivisions are excluded; candied/prepared fruit needs separate classification.
